films.title: Nights and Weekends
films.overview: A man and woman must face the tension that builds between them during a long-distance relationship.

films.title: Little Women
films.overview: Four sisters come of age in America in the aftermath of the Civil War.

films.title: Lady Bird
films.overview: Lady Bird McPherson, a strong willed, deeply opinionated, artistic 17 year old comes of age in Sacramento. Her relationship with her mother and her upbringing are questioned and tested as she plans to head off to college.

films.title: Barbie
films.overview: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.
